verdict.rationale: The docs say users can switch models mid-conversation across different AI providers. They also describe signing in to multiple provider accounts (e.g., Claude Max, Kimi For Coding) and per-mode model packs with fallback models. Missing for 10: documentation of the actual model-selection command or config syntax, a list of supported providers and models, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can choose which underlying AI model powers my session from multiple providers

citations.quote: Compare responses across different AI providers by switching models mid-conversation.
